change.bound: Two tab stops per rendered provider profile row, based on the source UI: the profile-open button and the separate delete button.

ci_evidence.failure: At test line 49, after one Tab, row.contains(document.activeElement) was false. Diagnostic: active element tag BUTTON, text E2E remote sandbox profile, aria-label null.

failed_screenshot.observation: Shows the Executors settings hub and the fixture provider profile row. It does not expose the focused node’s profile ID.

failed_error_context.note: The extracted diagnostics markdown repeats this same resource twice; the inner archive resource is the single failed error context.

diagnosis.observed_ui_contract: Each provider profile row is a div with executor-profile-card-{id}; it contains a primary native button named by the profile and a separate delete button. The chevron is decorative. The test helper uses the fixed visible profile name E2E remote sandbox profile and does not assert that this name is unique.
diagnosis.inference: The failure proves the active button had the expected visible name but not that it was the button in the row selected by profile ID. The original one-Tab assumption and text-only diagnostic could not distinguish a same-named row or a transient focus/DOM mismatch. The revised traversal targets the exact scoped button by locator identity.
diagnosis.uncertainty: The failed snapshot does not include the active button’s profile ID or a failed-attempt trace. The screenshot’s visible row does not resolve that identity. The specific runtime cause is therefore inferred, not proven; the CI retry passed and no local baseline has been run.
